thread:
sam: Quick heads-up: PR #598 has a CLI export example that legal found ambiguous about retention scope. They asked for clearer tenant vs org language.

anya: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/598. I see the CLI example uses --ttl without saying whether it's tenant-only.

tom: simple fix: label the CLI examples and add one line after each. e.g. 

```bash
# tenant-scoped: sets a 30-day TTL for tenant 'delta'
redwood audits export --tenant delta --since 2026-04-01 --ttl 2592000 --redact ip,email
```

# and a global/admin example

```bash
# global/admin: set org default retention (affects org-wide opt-ins)
redwood admin retention set --ttl 7776000
```

legal-jay: please include this sentence verbatim on SOC2 pages: "Retention settings shown are tenant-scoped unless labeled 'global/admin'. Indefinite retention may apply under legal hold." Keep it exactly like that.

sam: will add the legal line and a short parenthetical after the tenant CLI: '(Tenant retention applies only to logs for that tenant.)'

anya: small QA ask: ensure the docs mention private (VPC/on-prem) behavior: 'Private deployments may follow customer-managed retention and key policies.'

tom: will update PR with both tweaks and add matching examples in JS and Python SDK code blocks (compact).

docs-bot: PR #598 updated by tom  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/xyz789 :white_check_mark:

legal-jay: LGTM pending CI. If wording changes, run it by me briefly.

sam: thanks all  merging after CI.
